premise.claim: On base, a Runtime created without a pre-existing Dataset cannot proceed (strict Dataset-Runtime binding); no auto-create exists. Issue #4518 requests lifting this.
premise.evidence: results/layer0-base-premise.txt (base-only test file premise/zz_verify_pr5674_premise_test.go.base-only: runtime without dataset waits at 5s requeue, nothing created, annotation literal ignored on base)

integration.cmd: VERIFY_PR5674_ENVTEST=1 KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="${KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS:-$(ls -d $HOME/.local/share/kubebuilder-envtest/k8s/* 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)}" go test ./pkg/controllers/ -run TestControllers -count=1 -args -ginkgo.json-report="$GINKGO_REPORT.integration"

match: runtime without the annotation still waits and creates no dataset
findings.note: backward-compat guard: unannotated runtimes unchanged (green on base AND head)

match: annotated runtime auto-creates a stub dataset bound to itself
findings.note: feature proof: green on head, absent on base

match: terminating runtime with the annotation must not auto-create a dataset
findings.note: RED on head 63f43e26: auto-create runs before the deletion branch; proposed fix: gate on objectMeta.GetDeletionTimestamp().IsZero() (verified flips green)

match: engine ClusterRoles with dataset access grant owner finalizers update
findings.note: RED on head: no engine ClusterRole holds <engine>runtimes/finalizers update while blockOwnerDeletion=true is set; breaks on clusters with OwnerReferencesPermissionEnforcement enabled (default-off upstream)

match: I2 [canary]: first auto-create reconcile errors on empty-GVK ownerRef, second heals
findings.note: GREEN while bug present (first reconcile errors with empty-GVK ownerRef rejection, second heals via cache). Fixed only when it FLIPS to fail (i.e. first reconcile becomes clean).
